name: Social anarchism
summary: Social anarchism is the collectivist, left-wing branch of anarchism. It holds that liberty and solidarity go together, and that the state and capitalism are linked hierarchies to be replaced by common ownership and a bottom-up federation of free associations built on mutual aid. It favours direct action, direct decision-making and means that match its ends, and rejects parties, vanguards and the market.
scope: Social anarchism: the collectivist, class-struggle and revolutionary branch of anarchism, which Morland (s6) calls the classical anarchism of Bakunin and Kropotkin and which the FARJ (s7) defines as the anarchism of social transformation, in the line of Bakunin, Kropotkin and Malatesta and in Bookchin's dichotomy with lifestyle anarchism (s5). The Stanford Encyclopedia (s2) places it with anarchist communism and communitarian anarchism. Excludes individualist anarchism, anarcho-capitalism, lifestyle anarchism, primitivism and Marxist state socialism; mutualists and collectivists differ on wages and markets.

abolish-armed-forces.rationale: Bookchin, Social Anarchism or Lifestyle Anarchism ('Antimilitarism and Revolution'), approves a popular militia 'instead of the standing army' and says anarchists sought the direct arming of the masses against the state's monopoly of violence, and Post-Scarcity Anarchism says the goal is to oppose militarism, not just advocate disarmament.

abolish-division-of-labor.rationale: Kropotkin (Conquest of Bread, ch. XV 'The Division of Labour') attacks the division of labour created by industry and calls for the 'integration of functions' and combining manual and intellectual work; he does not call for abolishing all specialisation, so only partial agreement.

abolish-hereditary-privilege.rationale: Nulled: its only source, Anarchist Communism: Its Basis and Principles, isn't tied to the ideology.

abolish-income-tax.rationale: The qualifying sources record no position on this, and no stated principle settles it.

abolish-legal-marriage.rationale: Anarchists reject state-conferred marriage as an institution of authority, with free unions instead, though not all adherents press the issue.

abolish-money-wages.rationale: Bookchin, Post-Scarcity Anarchism (Introduction), says an anarcho-communist society presupposes the complete dissolution of commodity relationships; FARJ (economy section) likewise has the market abolished.

abolish-police-prisons.rationale: Kropotkin (Conquest of Bread, 'Our Riches') condemns the courts, judges, executioners, policemen and gaolers as an apparatus maintaining the privileges of the rich and says money spent on judges, prisons and policemen is spent 'to no purpose', since easing poverty reduces crime; he does not literally call for abolishing them.

abolish-wage-labour.rationale: Kropotkin (Conquest of Bread, ch. III 'Anarchist Communism') holds that a society with common ownership of the instruments of labour must abandon 'all forms of wages', since the wage system belongs to private ownership and perishes with capitalism; FARJ also treats wage-labour as the mechanism by which capitalists usurp the surplus.

algorithmic-government.rationale: Nulled: its only source, Anarchy, isn't tied to the ideology.

alienated-labor.rationale: Kropotkin (Conquest of Bread, ch. XV) says the capitalist division of labour condemns the worker for life to a fragment of a task, losing all interest in it, and Bookchin (Post-Scarcity Anarchism) says nothing is more meaningless than a lifetime of toil and that tasks have been broken down to ever more inhuman fragments; FARJ says capitalism separates manual and intellectual labour.

all-land-state-owned.rationale: FARJ (economy section) says it does not consider state ownership collective and that centralised state ownership in the USSR only made the state an employer, and Bookchin (Post-Scarcity Anarchism, Introduction) criticises the retained concept of 'nationalized' property.

allow-dual-citizenship.rationale: The qualifying sources record no position on this, and no stated principle settles it.

apologise-for-past-wrongs.rationale: The qualifying sources record no position on this, and no stated principle settles it.

arbitrator-settles-disputes.rationale: The qualifying sources record no position on this, and no stated principle settles it.

armed-group-creates-revolution.rationale: FARJ (social revolution section) says social revolution is made by the people of city and countryside through popular organisation, and that uprisings without prior organisational work fail to overthrow capitalism and the state, which excludes a small armed group creating the conditions.

armed-resistance-to-occupation.rationale: The qualifying sources record no position on this, and no stated principle settles it.

assimilate-immigrants.rationale: Cosmopolitanism and anti-statism leave no ground for compelled national assimilation.

automate-paid-work.rationale: Bookchin (Post-Scarcity Anarchism) says technology freed from profit would eliminate toil and give leisure to control society directly; FARJ (economy section) says technology used for labour will bring significant reduction in labour time; Kropotkin (Conquest of Bread) argues machinery allows short working hours.

automation-leaves-most-without-work.rationale: The qualifying sources record no position on this, and no stated principle settles it.

ban-cartels.rationale: Nulled: its only source, Social anarchism, isn't tied to the ideology.

ban-cattle-slaughter.rationale: Nulled: its only source, Anarchy, isn't tied to the ideology.

ban-patents-on-life.rationale: The qualifying sources record no position on this, and no stated principle settles it.

ban-spanking.rationale: The qualifying sources record no position on this, and no stated principle settles it.

bound-labor.rationale: Nulled: its only source, Anarchist Communism: Its Basis and Principles, isn't tied to the ideology.

build-apartments-freely.rationale: The qualifying sources record no position on this, and no stated principle settles it.

bypass-parties-groups.rationale: The qualifying sources record no position on this, and no stated principle settles it.

capitalism-adapts.rationale: Nulled: its only source, Anarchist Communism: Its Basis and Principles, isn't tied to the ideology.

capitalism-causes-war.rationale: Kropotkin (Conquest of Bread, ch. 'Our Riches') argues that industry, unable to sell to its own workers, seeks foreign markets, and that the nations competing there fall into 'perpetual wars' for precedence in the market; FARJ (section on the state and capitalism) ties imperialism and wars to capitalist expansion.

capitalism-progressive.rationale: Bookchin (Post-Scarcity Anarchism, 'Towards a Post-Scarcity Society') says bourgeois society revolutionised production on an unprecedented scale and that this technological revolution created the objective basis for a world without class rule, toil or material want; Kropotkin (Conquest of Bread, ch. I) likewise says the accumulated wealth of the present was made by industry's progress.

censor-art-for-virtue.rationale: Bookchin (Social Anarchism or Lifestyle Anarchism, 'The Commitment to Democracy') states that the Left That Was, anarchists included, viewed any abridgement of free expression as abhorrent and reactionary.

central-planning.rationale: Nulled: its only source, Anarchist Communism: Its Basis and Principles, isn't tied to the ideology.

change-traditions-that-no-longer-suit.rationale: The qualifying sources record no position on this, and no stated principle settles it.

character-from-environment.rationale: Bookchin, Post-Scarcity Anarchism (Introduction), says what is called 'human nature' largely reflects the cultural legacy of hierarchy, and in Social Anarchism or Lifestyle Anarchism (prehistory section) speaks of the mutability of human nature.

charity-over-state-aid.rationale: Nulled: its only source, Anarchist Communism: Its Basis and Principles, isn't tied to the ideology.

church-by-bishops.rationale: Anarchists reject hierarchical authority including clerical.

citizenship-by-descent.rationale: Citizenship by blood is a state device linked to ethnic nationalism, which they reject.

civil-disobedience-accept-penalty.rationale: The qualifying sources record no position on this, and no stated principle settles it.

civil-marriage.rationale: The qualifying sources record no position on this, and no stated principle settles it.

civilians-legitimate-targets.rationale: The qualifying sources record no position on this, and no stated principle settles it.

civilizing-tutelage.rationale: FARJ (section on class and centre-periphery relations) lists colonial and imperialist relations among the forms of domination and exploitation anarchism opposes, and Bookchin (Social Anarchism or Lifestyle Anarchism) says anarchists opposed the nation-state and domination everywhere.

class-collaboration.rationale: FARJ (opening sections, 'Social Anarchism, Class Struggle...') defines its anarchism as organised class-struggle anarchism, building the independent force of the exploited classes against capitalism and the state.

class-struggle-history.rationale: Bookchin stresses class relations and Bakunin class domination, but Kropotkin gives mutual aid a large role; not the sole driver.

collective-bargaining.rationale: Nulled: its only source, Social anarchism, isn't tied to the ideology.

collective-defense.rationale: Nulled: its only source, Anarchy, isn't tied to the ideology.

collective-farming.rationale: Nulled: its only source, Social anarchism, isn't tied to the ideology.

colonial-reparations.rationale: Nulled: its only source, Anarchist Communism: Its Basis and Principles, isn't tied to the ideology.

colonial-socialism-democratic-stage.rationale: Bookchin (Social Anarchism or Lifestyle Anarchism, 'The First World War and Bolshevism') criticises Lenin's national-liberation line to foster economic development in colonised countries as undermining the Left, and FARJ rejects any state-led interim stage.

colonies-serve-metropole.rationale: FARJ (centre-periphery section) names colonial and imperialist relations as domination and exploitation, and Kropotkin (Conquest of Bread, ch. I) condemns capital exploiting colonies and underdeveloped countries.

communal-electorates.rationale: The qualifying sources record no position on this, and no stated principle settles it.

competition-drives-progress.rationale: Nulled: its only source, Anarchist Communism: Its Basis and Principles, isn't tied to the ideology.

confederal-coordination.rationale: Social anarchism favours federation of free associations with delegates who coordinate while decisions stay with local assemblies, as Bookchin sets out.

conscription.rationale: Kropotkin (Conquest of Bread, ch. I 'Our Riches') lists the 'blood-tax (conscription)' among state impositions, and Bookchin (Social Anarchism or Lifestyle Anarchism, 'Antimilitarism and Revolution') says militarism regiments society and teaches obedience.

consent-of-governed.rationale: Nulled: its only source, Social anarchism, isn't tied to the ideology.

constitution-recognises-indigenous-natio.rationale: The qualifying sources record no position on this, and no stated principle settles it.

constitutional-jury-trial.rationale: The qualifying sources record no position on this, and no stated principle settles it.

cooperative-communities.rationale: Kropotkin (Conquest of Bread, Preface) sees free federated communes holding property in common as the form socialism takes (though not necessarily small), and Bookchin (Post-Scarcity Anarchism, Introduction and ecological-politics essays) rests society on self-governing municipalities.

corporate-influence.rationale: Nulled: its only source, Social anarchism, isn't tied to the ideology.

corporatist-bargaining.rationale: Nulled: its only source, Anarchist Communism: Its Basis and Principles, isn't tied to the ideology.

correct-racial-injustice.rationale: The qualifying sources record no position on this, and no stated principle settles it.

country-wealth-only-from-land.rationale: The qualifying sources record no position on this, and no stated principle settles it.

courts-bound-by-majority.rationale: Bookchin defends majoritarian democracy, while others reject courts and constitutions as state devices; split.

creationism-in-schools.rationale: Bookchin's defence of reason and secularism goes against teaching creationism as science.

criminalize-genocide-denial.rationale: The qualifying sources record no position on this, and no stated principle settles it.

criminalize-homosexuality.rationale: Bookchin (Post-Scarcity Anarchism, Introduction) lists gay liberation among the liberation movements he welcomes and says that when resources allow equality, nothing is more criminal to ethnic minorities, women and homosexuals than subjugation.

cultures-equal-different.rationale: Anarchist cosmopolitanism denies hierarchies between peoples.

customary-chiefs-lawmaking.rationale: The qualifying sources record no position on this, and no stated principle settles it.

death-penalty.rationale: Kropotkin (Conquest of Bread, 'Our Riches') names executioners together with courts, policemen and gaolers as part of the repressive apparatus serving privilege, though he does not discuss capital punishment for terrorism directly.

decent-living-guarantee.rationale: The qualifying sources record no position on this, and no stated principle settles it.

decide-locally.rationale: Bookchin (Post-Scarcity Anarchism, ecological-politics essays) locates politics in the municipality and its assembly, and FARJ and Kropotkin describe free federations of communes in which policy stays with the communes.

defeat-communism.rationale: Anarchists oppose states, including capitalist ones, and the claim that communism should be defeated by force is rejected, though authoritarian communism is criticised.

defeat-own-government-war.rationale: Nulled: its only source, Anarchy, isn't tied to the ideology.

defend-planned-state.rationale: FARJ (economy section) says state ownership as in the USSR is not collective ownership and only makes the state an employer that keeps exploiting workers, and rejects the authoritarian 'socialism' of a ruling bureaucracy.

deference-to-leading-power.rationale: FARJ (centre-periphery section) treats domination of peripheral states by a centre, whether colonial or imperialist, as an evil to be abolished, and Bookchin (Social Anarchism or Lifestyle Anarchism) opposes any centralised state power.

democracy-becomes-oligarchy.rationale: FARJ (representative democracy section) says representative democracy inevitably divides the class that does politics from the classes that follow and leaves the people as spectators; it does not say this holds of direct democracy, which anarchists favour.

democracy-best.rationale: Bookchin says a free society will be democratic, while Kropotkin and Malatesta reject majority rule and elected government; adherents are split.

democracy-is-procedure.rationale: FARJ (section on representative democracy) argues that electing representatives alienates people from politics and that no state, however democratic its forms, is free of domination; Bookchin (Social Anarchism or Lifestyle Anarchism, 'The Commitment to Democracy', and Post-Scarcity Anarchism) puts face-to-face assemblies at the base of real democracy.

democracy-needs-political-clash.rationale: The qualifying sources record no position on this, and no stated principle settles it.

democratic-peace.rationale: Nulled: its only source, Anarchist Communism: Its Basis and Principles, isn't tied to the ideology.

dense-cities.rationale: The qualifying sources record no position on this, and no stated principle settles it.

destroy-worshipped-objects.rationale: The qualifying sources record no position on this, and no stated principle settles it.

dictatorship-of-proletariat.rationale: FARJ (social revolution section) rejects the authoritarian idea of socialism as an interim dictatorship within the state as another way of continuing exploitation; Bookchin (Post-Scarcity Anarchism, Introduction) criticises the retained concepts of 'nationalized' property and 'proletarian dictatorship'.

direct-action.rationale: FARJ (section on social movements) supports 'direct action as a form of political action as opposed to representative democracy', telling movements not to entrust their cause to politicians, and describes politicians in the representative system as unable to act for the exploited.

direct-votes.rationale: Bookchin (Social Anarchism or Lifestyle Anarchism) says a free society must be democratic and calls the anarchist notion of democracy face-to-face, direct democracy by assembly; referendums on laws are not specifically discussed.

distribute-by-need.rationale: Kropotkin's Conquest of Bread (chs. II 'Well-Being for All', III 'Anarchist Communism' and XIII 'The Collectivist Wages System') argues distribution must follow need, not deeds; Bookchin's Post-Scarcity Anarchism (Introduction) says an anarcho-communist society presupposes 'distribution of goods according to individual needs'; FARJ (remuneration section) names 'to each according to their need' as the goal once abundance allows.

distribution-by-process.rationale: Nulled: its only source, Anarchist Communism: Its Basis and Principles, isn't tied to the ideology.

diversity-weakens-cohesion.rationale: Cosmopolitanism and mutual aid across lines go against it.

divine-source-of-authority.rationale: Bookchin (Social Anarchism or Lifestyle Anarchism, 'Secularism and Rationalism') says the anarchist Left saw the worship of deities as subjugation to human creations and the manipulation of fear by elites on behalf of an oppressive order, so authority grounded in God is rejected.

divinely-chosen-superior-people.rationale: Bookchin (Social Anarchism or Lifestyle Anarchism, 'Secularism and Rationalism' and 'Internationalism') says the anarchist Left rejected the worship of deities as subjugation and held a universal conception of humanity against particularistic loyalties.

dynastic-succession.rationale: Nulled: its only source, Anarchy, isn't tied to the ideology.

economic-self-sufficiency.rationale: Nulled: its only source, Anarchist Communism: Its Basis and Principles, isn't tied to the ideology.

economy-in-majority-hands.rationale: Nulled: its only source, Social anarchism, isn't tied to the ideology.

elective-rulers.rationale: Nulled: its only source, Anarchist Communism: Its Basis and Principles, isn't tied to the ideology.

elite-replacement.rationale: Bookchin and anarchists attribute social ills to capital and hierarchy, not conspiratorial replacement.

emergency-suspend-protections.rationale: Bookchin (Social Anarchism or Lifestyle Anarchism, 'Antimilitarism and Revolution') objects that militarism subordinates democratic rights in crisis situations such as war or revolution, and the anarchist Left treated abridgement of free expression as abhorrent.

empower-international-orgs.rationale: Nulled: its only source, Anarchist Communism: Its Basis and Principles, isn't tied to the ideology.

end-foreign-alliances.rationale: Nulled: its only source, Anarchy, isn't tied to the ideology.

environment-over-liberty.rationale: The qualifying sources record no position on this, and no stated principle settles it.

equal-moral-worth.rationale: Nulled: its only source, Anarchist Communism: Its Basis and Principles, isn't tied to the ideology.

equal-outcomes.rationale: FARJ (economy section) says the new system rests on 'social, political and economic equality' together with freedom and endorses equal pay; need-based distribution rather than identical outcomes is the stated end.

ethnic-nation.rationale: Anarchist cosmopolitanism and anti-statism leave no place for ethnically defined states.

ethnicity-statistics.rationale: The qualifying sources record no position on this, and no stated principle settles it.

every-country-ready-for-democracy.rationale: The qualifying sources record no position on this, and no stated principle settles it.

evolved-behavioural-sex-differences.rationale: The qualifying sources record no position on this, and no stated principle settles it.

exclude-trans-women-women-only-spaces.rationale: The qualifying sources record no position on this, and no stated principle settles it.

experts-over-public.rationale: Bookchin (Post-Scarcity Anarchism, 1986 introduction) explicitly distances his liberatory technology from technocracy and wants social elites' power dissolved into the people, and FARJ (economy section) requires rotation of functions so specialists do not hold power.

extrajudicial-killing.rationale: FARJ (social revolution section) states that violence is justified only when needed to defend oneself or others against violence, and Kropotkin (Conquest of Bread, ch. I) condemns state executioners and courts as instruments of privilege.

farm-price-support.rationale: Nulled: its only source, Anarchist Communism: Its Basis and Principles, isn't tied to the ideology.

femininity-compatible-with-feminism.rationale: The qualifying sources record no position on this, and no stated principle settles it.

force-to-prevent-secession.rationale: Nulled: its only source, Anarchist Communism: Its Basis and Principles, isn't tied to the ideology.

force-without-un.rationale: Nulled: its only source, Anarchy, isn't tied to the ideology.

foreign-policy-non-interference.rationale: The qualifying sources record no position on this, and no stated principle settles it.

former-empire-equal-treatment.rationale: Nulled: its only source, Anarchist Communism: Its Basis and Principles, isn't tied to the ideology.

four-day-week.rationale: The qualifying sources record no position on this, and no stated principle settles it.

free-basic-services-for-all.rationale: Kropotkin (Conquest of Bread, chs. V-VII on food, dwellings and clothing) wants necessities supplied on the principle 'take what you need' from communal stores, without payment, as already happens with water; he frames this as communal supply rather than state public services.

free-economic-experiment.rationale: Morland (Changing Anarchism, ch. 1/Introduction) summarises classical anarchism as holding that plans for the future should be determined by activists in situ rather than by revolutionary blueprints; Kropotkin and Bookchin nonetheless each sketch a communal economy, so support is partial.

free-trade.rationale: Nulled: its only source, Anarchist Communism: Its Basis and Principles, isn't tied to the ideology.

free-trade-promotes-peace.rationale: The qualifying sources record no position on this, and no stated principle settles it.

freedom-as-non-domination.rationale: Bookchin (Social Anarchism or Lifestyle Anarchism, 'The Commitment to Democracy') quotes Bakunin that freedom includes 'the independence of the will of everyone from the will of others', and FARJ treats hierarchy and domination as themselves the evil, whether or not coercion is applied.

freedom-is-self-government-of-desire.rationale: The qualifying sources record no position on this, and no stated principle settles it.

freedom-to-discriminate.rationale: The right to refuse association rests on private property, which anarchists reject, and equality is central.

future-generations.rationale: Bookchin's social ecology treats the ecological crisis as caused by hierarchy and capitalism and makes protecting the living world central.

generational-constitutional-review.rationale: The qualifying sources record no position on this, and no stated principle settles it.

government-encourage-intercultural-conta.rationale: The qualifying sources record no position on this, and no stated principle settles it.

government-nudges.rationale: The qualifying sources record no position on this, and no stated principle settles it.

gradual-change.rationale: Bookchin insists on social revolution, and Malatesta wants private property and government abolished by revolutionary action rather than by gradual reform.

harassment-claims-court-access.rationale: The qualifying sources record no position on this, and no stated principle settles it.

harm-principle.rationale: Nulled: its only source, Anarchy, isn't tied to the ideology.

head-of-state-dissolves-parliament.rationale: The qualifying sources record no position on this, and no stated principle settles it.

hereditarian-race.rationale: Nulled: its only source, Anarchist Communism: Its Basis and Principles, isn't tied to the ideology.

heritable-defect-limits.rationale: Nulled: its only source, Anarchist Communism: Its Basis and Principles, isn't tied to the ideology.

homeland-spiritual-bond.rationale: Nulled: its only source, Social anarchism, isn't tied to the ideology.

homestead-ownership.rationale: Kropotkin (Conquest of Bread, 'Expropriation') treats land and the instruments of labour as the common inheritance of all, and FARJ (economy section) says property is always collective with only individual possession of what one uses; first use does not create ownership.

human-caused-global-warming.rationale: Bookchin (Post-Scarcity Anarchism, ecology essay on pollution) says industrial and domestic combustion has raised atmospheric carbon dioxide by about a quarter in a century and that the expected greenhouse effect would raise temperatures, though he words the warming as an expectation rather than a settled fact.

human-decline-since-golden-age.rationale: Bookchin (Social Anarchism or Lifestyle Anarchism, sections on primitivism) attacks the 'edenic glorification of prehistory' and anticivilizationism, defending technology, secularism, science and reason as real human advances.

humans-entitled-to-use-animals.rationale: The qualifying sources record no position on this, and no stated principle settles it.

immigrants-learn-language.rationale: The qualifying sources record no position on this, and no stated principle settles it.

immigration-favours-shared-culture.rationale: The qualifying sources record no position on this, and no stated principle settles it.

income-for-work-not-ownership.rationale: Kropotkin (Conquest of Bread) condemns the idlers who live on the toil of the workers through ownership and wants the common inheritance enjoyed in common, and FARJ says no one would gain income by owning means of production; however both reject pay-by-deeds as such.

independent-nuclear-deterrent.rationale: Nulled: its only source, Anarchy, isn't tied to the ideology.

independent-unions.rationale: Nulled: its only source, Social anarchism, isn't tied to the ideology.

indigenous-internal-justice.rationale: The qualifying sources record no position on this, and no stated principle settles it.

individual-pension-accounts.rationale: Nulled: its only source, Anarchist Communism: Its Basis and Principles, isn't tied to the ideology.

individual-rights-only.rationale: Bookchin prefers social freedom and says individuality is formed socially, and Malatesta makes freedom complementary.

industrial-civilization-disaster.rationale: Bookchin rejects primitivism and blames capitalist commodity relations, not technology or civilization, for ecological harm.

industrial-unions.rationale: Nulled: its only source, Social anarchism, isn't tied to the ideology.

informal-organisation.rationale: Bookchin (Social Anarchism or Lifestyle Anarchism, opening sections) says lifestyle anarchists are losing contact with the need for an organized, collectivistic, programmatic opposition and criticises affinity-group disorganisation, praising the organised movements of earlier anarchists; FARJ (organisation sections) says a consistent anarchist organisation is needed to hold political space.

initiating-nondefensive-force-unjustifie.rationale: FARJ (social revolution section) holds that 'violence is only justifiable when it is necessary in order to defend oneself or others against violence', presenting revolutionary violence as a response to the violence of state and capital.

interfaith-marriage-restriction.rationale: Nulled: its only source, Anarchy, isn't tied to the ideology.

job-guarantee.rationale: Kropotkin (Conquest of Bread, ch. II 'Well-Being for All') rejects the 'right to work', which he says means only the right to be a wage-slave on the treadmill of commerce, and criticises the 1848 national workshops that tried to deliver it.

keep-nuclear-weapons.rationale: The qualifying sources record no position on this, and no stated principle settles it.

keep-public-institutions-small.rationale: Bookchin (Post-Scarcity Anarchism) wants decentralised, human-scale communities and municipal assemblies in place of the centralised state; Kropotkin (Conquest of Bread, ch. on the commune) pictures federated communes.

kin-peoples-union.rationale: Anarchists reject nationalism and state unification by ancestry.

labour-priority-over-capital.rationale: The qualifying sources record no position on this, and no stated principle settles it.

land-redistribution.rationale: Nulled: its only source, Anarchist Communism: Its Basis and Principles, isn't tied to the ideology.

land-use-tenure.rationale: FARJ (economy section) says that where peasants work their own land it should be understood as possession, not property, because the land's value lies in its use while property stays collective.

language-defines-nation.rationale: Anarchism opposes the nation-state and nationalism and puts voluntary federation above national identity, though it respects cultural and linguistic communities.

laws-from-scripture.rationale: Anarchists reject law itself and Kropotkin says morality is independent of and anterior to law and religion.

left-right-obsolete.rationale: Social anarchism is a left-wing tradition and rejects combining with right-wing ideas; Bookchin defends its collectivist left identity.

legal-duty-to-work.rationale: Kropotkin (Conquest of Bread, ch. V) says a society where work is free has nothing to fear from idlers and relies on free agreement rather than legal compulsion; everyone working is expected, but not under law.

legalize-drugs.rationale: Nulled: its only source, Anarchy, isn't tied to the ideology.

limit-campaign-donations.rationale: The qualifying sources record no position on this, and no stated principle settles it.

local-essentials-public.rationale: Nulled: its only source, Anarchist Communism: Its Basis and Principles, isn't tied to the ideology.

local-production.rationale: Bookchin (Post-Scarcity Anarchism, ecology essays) argues that a relatively self-sufficient community would be more efficient than the exaggerated national division of labour and that most economic activity can be scaled to communitarian dimensions; Kropotkin's ch. XVI 'Decentralization of Industry' makes the same case.

local-veto-new-housing.rationale: The qualifying sources record no position on this, and no stated principle settles it.

long-naturalization-wait.rationale: Borders and citizenship as state tools lack legitimacy in their cosmopolitanism.

majority-settlement.rationale: Anarchists oppose state steering of populations and nation-building.

mandatory-environmental-reporting.rationale: The qualifying sources record no position on this, and no stated principle settles it.

mandatory-sentences.rationale: Nulled: its only source, Anarchist Communism: Its Basis and Principles, isn't tied to the ideology.

market-under-party-rule.rationale: FARJ (economy and state sections) says the market should be abolished in favour of self-managed planning and rejects party or state rule as exploitation continued, so a market socialism led by a communist party is rejected.

markets-allocate-better.rationale: Nulled: its only source, Anarchist Communism: Its Basis and Principles, isn't tied to the ideology.

material-conditions-drive-history.rationale: Nulled: its only source, Anarchist Communism: Its Basis and Principles, isn't tied to the ideology.

maximum-personal-income.rationale: The qualifying sources record no position on this, and no stated principle settles it.

means-match-ends.rationale: FARJ (social revolution section) says the means of struggle must be built 'in accordance with the society that we wish to build', with self-management and federalism practised in the struggle beforehand; it contrasts this with state-seizing political revolutions that reproduce domination.

member-state-blocks-federal-overreach.rationale: The qualifying sources record no position on this, and no stated principle settles it.

military-force-beyond-defence.rationale: The qualifying sources record no position on this, and no stated principle settles it.

military-force-for-human-rights.rationale: The qualifying sources record no position on this, and no stated principle settles it.

military-guardian-role.rationale: Nulled: its only source, Anarchy, isn't tied to the ideology.

military-organisation-revolutionary-part.rationale: The qualifying sources record no position on this, and no stated principle settles it.

military-superiority.rationale: Nulled: its only source, Anarchy, isn't tied to the ideology.

minority-conspiracy.rationale: Anarchists see conspiracy theories about minorities as reaction and oppose nationalism and racism on principle.

minority-veto.rationale: Bookchin (Social Anarchism or Lifestyle Anarchism) argues that giving a minority of one the right to abort a majority's decision is incompatible with a democratic free society, whereas Stanford (s2, section on non-rule) presents unanimity and consensus as the positive anarchist ideal of non-coercive association.

mixed-constitution.rationale: It blends forms of state rule, all of which anarchists reject.

mixed-public-service-providers.rationale: Nulled: its only source, Anarchist Communism: Its Basis and Principles, isn't tied to the ideology.

monarchy-legitimate.rationale: Hereditary rule is a plain case of the domination social anarchists reject.

money-backed-by-precious-metals.rationale: The qualifying sources record no position on this, and no stated principle settles it.

moral-incentives.rationale: Nulled: its only source, Anarchist Communism: Its Basis and Principles, isn't tied to the ideology.

more-religion-public.rationale: Bakunin rejected God as absolute master and anarchists are anticlerical; religion should not shape public power.

municipal-businesses-mixed-economy.rationale: The qualifying sources record no position on this, and no stated principle settles it.

municipal-property.rationale: Common ownership by free communes is central to anarchist communism, and Bookchin's municipalism builds on the community level.

mutual-intelligibility-defines-language.rationale: The qualifying sources record no position on this, and no stated principle settles it.

nation-first.rationale: Bookchin (Social Anarchism or Lifestyle Anarchism, 'Internationalism, Nationalism, and Confederation') reports that anarchists were more hostile than Marxists to nationalism and quotes Bakunin that everyone seeking peace should renounce the glory, might and egoistic interests of the Fatherland and place universal justice above national interests.

national-church-status.rationale: The qualifying sources record no position on this, and no stated principle settles it.

national-law-over-international.rationale: Anarchists reject the sovereignty of every state constitution and courts, and often back international solidarity.

national-mission.rationale: Nulled: its only source, Anarchist Communism: Its Basis and Principles, isn't tied to the ideology.

native-born-offices.rationale: Anarchists reject state offices and nationalism, and are internationalist.

natural-rulers.rationale: Bookchin (Post-Scarcity Anarchism, Introduction, footnote on 'Power to the people') says power can only reach the people when the power of social elites is dissolved into them, and calls for control by each individual of daily life; rule by a naturally fitted few is the opposite.

nature-as-capital.rationale: The qualifying sources record no position on this, and no stated principle settles it.

neither-capitalism-nor-communism.rationale: Bookchin, Post-Scarcity Anarchism (Introduction), treats state capitalism and Marxist 'nationalized' property with its proletarian dictatorship as retaining classes and property, and Social Anarchism or Lifestyle Anarchism rejects Bolshevism and Stalinism; the alternative put forward is libertarian communism.

never-kill-self-defence.rationale: FARJ (social revolution section) states that violence is justifiable when needed to defend oneself or others against violence, and says direct action may be violent when it is self-defence against the system of domination.

no-business-privileges.rationale: Nulled: its only source, Social anarchism, isn't tied to the ideology.

no-central-bank.rationale: The qualifying sources record no position on this, and no stated principle settles it.

no-duty-to-obey.rationale: Anarchism holds that there is no general duty to obey the state; Malatesta and Kropotkin reject the legitimacy of governmental law.

no-land-for-peace.rationale: Anarchists reject historic territorial claims and the sanctity of borders.

no-transition-to-communism.rationale: Bookchin (Post-Scarcity Anarchism) says no 'transitional' stages or centralised organisations are needed between the existing and the possible, and Kropotkin (Conquest of Bread, ch. III 'Anarchist Communism') rejects collectivist wages as a stage; FARJ, however, accepts remuneration by labour as a stage before need-based distribution while rejecting any state transition.

noblesse-oblige.rationale: Nulled: its only source, Anarchist Communism: Its Basis and Principles, isn't tied to the ideology.

nonpartisan-head-of-state.rationale: Any head of state is a hierarchy to be abolished.

office-by-exam.rationale: Nulled: its only source, Anarchist Communism: Its Basis and Principles, isn't tied to the ideology.

one-party-rule.rationale: FARJ (political-level section) rejects the authoritarian vanguard party that dominates the social movements, and Bookchin (Social Anarchism or Lifestyle Anarchism, 'The Commitment to Democracy') endorses Luxemburg's rejection of freedom only for members of one party.

one-spouse-at-a-time.rationale: Bookchin (Post-Scarcity Anarchism, Introduction) says that in a post-scarcity society there is no longer any social rationale for monogamy and patriarchy; he does not discuss legal bans on multiple spouses.

opposition-only-legal-channels.rationale: FARJ (section on social movements and revolution) says movements should always remain combative and use direct action, makes violent revolution necessary, and rejects relying on the representative system, so legal channels alone are not enough.

organic-representation.rationale: Nulled: its only source, Anarchist Communism: Its Basis and Principles, isn't tied to the ideology.

parents-choose-intersex-surgery.rationale: The qualifying sources record no position on this, and no stated principle settles it.

parliament-supreme.rationale: Kropotkin (Conquest of Bread, ch. III 'Anarchist Communism') says representative government is impotent and parliamentarianism has failed, and FARJ (representative democracy section) calls parliament a pillar of capitalism.

parliamentary-road-socialism.rationale: FARJ (section on the state and representative democracy) argues that parliament and the state are pillars of capitalism that cannot be changed from inside and that elected representatives are transformed by the system; change through the state is rejected.

participatory-democracy.rationale: Direct decision-making and self-managed free associations are central; Bookchin defends direct democracy in communities.

party-discipline-binding.rationale: Nulled: its only source, Social anarchism, isn't tied to the ideology.

patriarchy-structural.rationale: Anarcha-feminism holds male domination is a hierarchy to be abolished; SEP names Goldman.

patriotic-education.rationale: Bookchin (Social Anarchism or Lifestyle Anarchism, 'Internationalism, Nationalism, and Confederation') shows the anarchist Left rejecting 'patriotism' and quotes Bakunin urging all to renounce the patriotism of the Fatherland; teaching patriotism in schools is not directly addressed.

pay-for-effort.rationale: Kropotkin (Conquest of Bread, Collectivist Wages System) rejects remuneration by deeds or labour, while FARJ (remuneration section) describes pay by work or effort as the model for libertarian socialism until abundance allows distribution by need.

pay-off-national-debt.rationale: The qualifying sources record no position on this, and no stated principle settles it.

people-in-arms.rationale: Bookchin (Social Anarchism or Lifestyle Anarchism, 'Antimilitarism and Revolution') says the arming of the people was a basic tenet of the Left That Was and of anarchists in particular, who sought the direct arming of the masses and a popular militia instead of a standing army.

person-over-state.rationale: The qualifying sources record no position on this, and no stated principle settles it.

personal-possessions-private.rationale: Kropotkin (Conquest of Bread, ch. IV 'Expropriation' and ch. VII 'Clothing') says expropriation does not mean taking anyone's coat ('let him who has a coat keep it still') while the instruments of production become common.

physical-labour-duty.rationale: Kropotkin (Conquest of Bread, ch. IX 'The Need for Luxury') expects everyone to do a few hours of manual work for their existence and says that when 'all will have to work with their hands' the stigma of manual labour will disappear.

political-borders-follow-ecosystems.rationale: The qualifying sources record no position on this, and no stated principle settles it.

political-decisions-consensus.rationale: Bookchin (Social Anarchism or Lifestyle Anarchism) says consensus decision-making lets a minority manipulate or stall decisions and favours direct-democratic majority procedures, while Stanford (s2, section on non-rule) associates consensus and unanimity with the positive anarchist ideal.

political-elite-corrupt.rationale: FARJ (section on representative democracy) says politicians make decisions that favour their party and their own interests and come to like the taste of power; Kropotkin (Conquest of Bread, ch. III) denounces the vices inherent in representative government.

political-violence-legitimate.rationale: FARJ (social revolution section) holds that violence is necessary in revolution but justifiable only as defence against the violence of the state and capital ('only justifiable when it is necessary in order to defend oneself or others'), so violence is endorsed conditionally, not generally.

politics-spiritual-struggle.rationale: Nulled: its only source, Anarchy, isn't tied to the ideology.

pollution-tort-liability.rationale: Nulled: its only source, Social anarchism, isn't tied to the ideology.

population-causes-poverty.rationale: Nulled: its only source, Anarchist Communism: Its Basis and Principles, isn't tied to the ideology.

positive-liberty.rationale: Bookchin (Post-Scarcity Anarchism) argues that freedom depends on material abundance and leisure, since people burdened by material want cannot control their affairs, and Kropotkin (Conquest of Bread, ch. II) makes the 'Right to Well-Being' the base of freedom.

power-shapes-accepted-knowledge.rationale: The qualifying sources record no position on this, and no stated principle settles it.

power-sharing-divided-societies.rationale: Nulled: its only source, Anarchy, isn't tied to the ideology.

press-owned-by-wealth.rationale: Nulled: its only source, Anarchy, isn't tied to the ideology.

price-controls-fight-inflation.rationale: The qualifying sources record no position on this, and no stated principle settles it.

price-stability-first.rationale: The qualifying sources record no position on this, and no stated principle settles it.

priority-to-poor.rationale: Nulled: its only source, Anarchist Communism: Its Basis and Principles, isn't tied to the ideology.

private-courts-defense.rationale: Nulled: its only source, Social anarchism, isn't tied to the ideology.

production-for-use.rationale: Kropotkin (Conquest of Bread, early chapters) condemns production for 'whatever offers the greatest profits to the monopolists' instead of the necessaries of life for all, and puts 'Well-Being for All' as the aim; Bookchin (Post-Scarcity Anarchism) wants technology freed from 'all consideration of profit and loss' and turned toward human needs.

profit-exploitation.rationale: FARJ (section on class and wage labour) presents the classic socialist thesis that by wage labour capitalists pay workers as little as possible and usurp the surplus of their labour, so that private property, as Proudhon said, is theft.

prohibit-child-medical-transition.rationale: The qualifying sources record no position on this, and no stated principle settles it.

promote-democracy-abroad.rationale: The qualifying sources record no position on this, and no stated principle settles it.

promote-ethnic-return-migration.rationale: The qualifying sources record no position on this, and no stated principle settles it.

promulgated-standing-laws.rationale: Nulled: its only source, Anarchy, isn't tied to the ideology.

pronatalist-incentives.rationale: Anarchists reject state natalist programmes and the nation as a unit, and favour open borders; no pronatalist policy is endorsed.

property-franchise.rationale: Nulled: its only source, Anarchy, isn't tied to the ideology.

property-fundamental.rationale: FARJ (class section) endorses Proudhon's view that private property is theft, Kropotkin (Conquest of Bread, ch. IV 'Expropriation') makes expropriation of property the necessary means, and Bookchin (Post-Scarcity Anarchism, Introduction) says anarcho-communism presupposes its abolition.

property-sabotage-justified.rationale: Stanford (s2, section 3.1) reports that Goldman held anti-capitalist sabotage ethical and that militant anarchists advocate direct action including sabotage, while anarcho-pacifists object; FARJ (social movements section) allows direct action to be more or less violent depending on circumstance.

property-serves-common-good.rationale: Nulled: its only source, Anarchist Communism: Its Basis and Principles, isn't tied to the ideology.

proportional-representation.rationale: Nulled: its only source, Anarchy, isn't tied to the ideology.

public-access-to-information.rationale: The qualifying sources record no position on this, and no stated principle settles it.

public-ownership.rationale: Kropotkin (Conquest of Bread, Expropriation) wants land, factories and the instruments of production to be common property, but FARJ states that state ownership is not collective ownership and rejects it, so only non-state public ownership is endorsed.

publish-international-agreements.rationale: The qualifying sources record no position on this, and no stated principle settles it.

punish-blasphemy.rationale: Bookchin (Social Anarchism or Lifestyle Anarchism, 'The Commitment to Democracy' and 'Secularism and Rationalism') says any abridgement of free expression was abhorrent to the anarchist Left and that it treated worship of deities as subjugation to human creations.

race-based-immigration-restrictions.rationale: Bookchin (Social Anarchism or Lifestyle Anarchism, 'Internationalism, Nationalism, and Confederation') says the anarchist Left saw national boundaries as barbed wire dividing human from human by particularistic loyalties, and FARJ says racial prejudice must be combated.

racial-community-economic-control.rationale: The qualifying sources record no position on this, and no stated principle settles it.

racial-franchise.rationale: Bookchin (Social Anarchism or Lifestyle Anarchism, 'The Commitment to Democracy') says anarchist democracy is face-to-face popular rule resting on universal humanity, and the anarchist Left rejected nationalism and particularistic divisions; FARJ says racial prejudice must be combated.

racial-oppression-before-sexism.rationale: The qualifying sources record no position on this, and no stated principle settles it.

reason-over-faith.rationale: Bookchin values reason and secularism, though not at the expense of care and solidarity.

recallable-delegates.rationale: Bookchin (Social Anarchism or Lifestyle Anarchism, 'Internationalism, Nationalism, and Confederation') describes the anarchist confederal model as communes uniting through recallable delegates whose functions are strictly administrative.

recognize-territorial-claims-from-conque.rationale: The qualifying sources record no position on this, and no stated principle settles it.

reduce-immigration.rationale: The qualifying sources record no position on this, and no stated principle settles it.

refuse-to-join-illegitimate-government.rationale: The qualifying sources record no position on this, and no stated principle settles it.

regional-powers-revocable.rationale: The qualifying sources record no position on this, and no stated principle settles it.

regional-resource-ownership.rationale: The qualifying sources record no position on this, and no stated principle settles it.

rehabilitation.rationale: Nulled: its only source, Anarchist Communism: Its Basis and Principles, isn't tied to the ideology.

religion-from-peoples-character.rationale: The qualifying sources record no position on this, and no stated principle settles it.

religion-illusion.rationale: Bakunin's critique treats religion as a consolation for oppression that will fade with freedom; adherents mostly agree, though some stress spirituality.

religions-one-truth.rationale: Anarchists are largely atheist and opposed to organised religion, rejecting religious claims to authority; the claim of a shared spiritual truth is not part of their thought.

religious-exemptions.rationale: Nulled: its only source, Anarchy, isn't tied to the ideology.

religious-offensive-war.rationale: The qualifying sources record no position on this, and no stated principle settles it.

remove-indigenous-peoples.rationale: Bookchin (Social Anarchism or Lifestyle Anarchism, 'Internationalism, Nationalism, and Confederation') quotes Bakunin on the right of even the smallest folk-unit to exercise its own rights as a community and places universal justice above national interests.

remove-other-ethnic-groups-from-country.rationale: Bookchin (Social Anarchism or Lifestyle Anarchism, 'Internationalism, Nationalism, and Confederation') says anarchists opposed nationalism and national boundaries as divisions of humanity and held a universalised conception of humanity; FARJ says racial prejudice must be combated.

rent-control.rationale: Nulled: its only source, Anarchist Communism: Its Basis and Principles, isn't tied to the ideology.

replace-appointed-officials.rationale: The qualifying sources record no position on this, and no stated principle settles it.

reserved-seats-excluded-groups.rationale: The qualifying sources record no position on this, and no stated principle settles it.

residents-only-property.rationale: Nulled: its only source, Anarchist Communism: Its Basis and Principles, isn't tied to the ideology.

resist-oppression-despite-death.rationale: The qualifying sources record no position on this, and no stated principle settles it.

resources-common-ownership.rationale: Nulled: its only source, Anarchist Communism: Its Basis and Principles, isn't tied to the ideology.

restore-past-order.rationale: Nulled: its only source, Anarchist Communism: Its Basis and Principles, isn't tied to the ideology.

restrict-conversion.rationale: Nulled: its only source, Anarchy, isn't tied to the ideology.

restrict-foreign-funding.rationale: Nulled: its only source, Social anarchism, isn't tied to the ideology.

restrict-freedoms-for-growth.rationale: Bookchin (Social Anarchism or Lifestyle Anarchism, 'The Left That Was' on democracy and the Bolshevik revolution) says the Left That Was treated abridgement of freedom as abhorrent and that Bolshevik rule by decree brutalised public life; FARJ says the means must match the society wanted.

restrict-hate-speech.rationale: Bookchin (Social Anarchism or Lifestyle Anarchism, 'The Commitment to Democracy') says the Left That Was viewed any abridgement of free expression as abhorrent; hate speech as a category is not discussed.

restrict-strikes-picketing.rationale: Nulled: its only source, Anarchist Communism: Its Basis and Principles, isn't tied to the ideology.

restrict-technology-exports-to-rivals.rationale: The qualifying sources record no position on this, and no stated principle settles it.

restructure-world-economy.rationale: Anarchists seek to abolish capitalism and the state, not reform trade and debt rules, although many support debt cancellation for poor countries; adherents split.

return-lost-territory.rationale: Anarchists oppose state territorial claims and nationalism.

return-to-foraging.rationale: Bookchin explicitly rejects anti-technology primitivism and says reason and technology can free people from toil.

return-to-pre-conversion-religion.rationale: The qualifying sources record no position on this, and no stated principle settles it.

revolution-legitimate.rationale: FARJ (section on social revolution) calls the violent alteration of the established order 'the only way to put an end to domination and exploitation'; Kropotkin (Conquest of Bread, ch. Expropriation) argues revolution and expropriation are necessary.

rich-first.rationale: Nulled: its only source, Anarchist Communism: Its Basis and Principles, isn't tied to the ideology.

rule-by-example.rationale: Nulled: its only source, Anarchy, isn't tied to the ideology.

sacred-nation.rationale: Anarchism rejects nationalism and the sacralising of the nation-state as a source of hierarchy.

sacrifice-heritage.rationale: Bookchin defends cultural and rational heritage and rejects hostility to civilization.

say-in-proportion-to-effect.rationale: FARJ (section on self-management and federalism) defines self-management as decisions made by the workers themselves 'to the extent by which they are affected by them' in their workplaces or communities.

scripture-inerrant.rationale: The qualifying sources record no position on this, and no stated principle settles it.

second-chamber.rationale: Nulled: its only source, Anarchy, isn't tied to the ideology.

self-interest-moral.rationale: Bookchin (Social Anarchism or Lifestyle Anarchism) rejects Stirner's sovereign ego and the 'sanctification of the self', quoting Kropotkin that individual freedom and reason are products of society; Kropotkin (Conquest of Bread) criticises the 'egoistic turn' of commercial society.

separated-powers.rationale: It tames the state but preserves it; social anarchists reject limited government as well.

shared-marital-authority.rationale: Bookchin (Post-Scarcity Anarchism, Introduction) says the patriarchal family arose from scarcity together with private property, class and the state and that there is no longer a rationale for patriarchy; FARJ (section on prejudice) says patriarchy and gender prejudice must be combated in the struggle and the revolution.

shut-down-tax-havens.rationale: The qualifying sources record no position on this, and no stated principle settles it.

slavery-reparations.rationale: The qualifying sources record no position on this, and no stated principle settles it.

small-step-social-reform.rationale: Bookchin (Social Anarchism or Lifestyle Anarchism) says the revolutionary Left wanted to overthrow capitalism rather than rationalise it, and FARJ (social revolution section) calls for destroying the state and replacing established structures by federated self-managed ones.

smash-state-machine.rationale: FARJ (social revolution section) says the revolution must immediately destroy the state and put self-managed, federated structures in its place; Kropotkin (Conquest of Bread) likewise calls for free federated communes in place of the State.

social-market-economy.rationale: Bookchin (Social Anarchism or Lifestyle Anarchism, 'The Left That Was' on reform) says the revolutionary Left saw 'capitalism with a human face' as a contradiction in terms and wanted to replace the system; FARJ says the market would be abolished.

socialism-needs-revolutionary-war.rationale: The qualifying sources record no position on this, and no stated principle settles it.

socialism-needs-workers-power.rationale: FARJ (social revolution section) quotes the First International motto that the emancipation of the workers must be the task of the workers themselves, and builds popular power through self-management, though it aims at abolishing the state rather than at holding it.

socialized-care.rationale: Nulled: its only source, Anarchist Communism: Its Basis and Principles, isn't tied to the ideology.

socialized-markets.rationale: FARJ (economy section) says the market would be abolished and replaced by self-managed planning between workers' and consumers' councils; Kropotkin likewise rejects exchange-based schemes, so a market of competing worker-owned firms is not the anarchist model.

soldiers-refuse-war.rationale: Anarchism is anti-militarist and opposes state wars, and refusal to serve is a longstanding tactic.

state-arms-monopoly.rationale: Bookchin (Social Anarchism or Lifestyle Anarchism, 'Antimilitarism and Revolution') says demands for gun control would have been alien to the anarchist and socialist Left, and that anarchists wanted to countervail the state's monopoly of violence with an armed popular movement.

state-class-instrument.rationale: Bakunin: where there is a state one class dominates another; Kropotkin ties government to class division.

state-directs-investment.rationale: Nulled: its only source, Anarchist Communism: Its Basis and Principles, isn't tied to the ideology.

state-finances-worker-businesses.rationale: The qualifying sources record no position on this, and no stated principle settles it.

state-harmful.rationale: Bakunin says where there is a State one class dominates another; the state is a coercive hierarchy to be abolished.

state-laws-apply-online.rationale: The qualifying sources record no position on this, and no stated principle settles it.

state-promotes-atheism.rationale: Anarchists oppose state schooling and state-imposed doctrine of any kind, including atheism, though they are broadly anti-clerical and secular.

state-strengthens-encirclement.rationale: FARJ (social revolution section) says the violent revolution must immediately destroy the state, and calls the authoritarian view of an interim state period another way to continue exploitation; strengthening state power is the opposite course.

state-supports-good-ways-of-life.rationale: The qualifying sources record no position on this, and no stated principle settles it.

strong-leader.rationale: Bookchin (Post-Scarcity Anarchism, Introduction, footnote) warns that if power goes to the 'leaders' of the people the people remain a manipulable mass, as powerless after the revolution as before; FARJ (political-level section) rejects the vanguard that places itself above the base.

students-direct-own-learning.rationale: The qualifying sources record no position on this, and no stated principle settles it.

suppress-opposition.rationale: Bookchin (Social Anarchism or Lifestyle Anarchism, 'The Commitment to Democracy') says the Left That Was viewed any abridgement of free expression as abhorrent and endorses Luxemburg's 'freedom for the one who thinks differently'; Bolshevik suppression of other parties is condemned.

tariffs-protect-industry.rationale: Nulled: its only source, Anarchist Communism: Its Basis and Principles, isn't tied to the ideology.

tax-holding-cash.rationale: The qualifying sources record no position on this, and no stated principle settles it.

taxation-theft.rationale: The qualifying sources record no position on this, and no stated principle settles it.

tech-solves-problems.rationale: The qualifying sources record no position on this, and no stated principle settles it.

technology-design-reflects-political-int.rationale: The qualifying sources record no position on this, and no stated principle settles it.

territorial-expansion.rationale: Bookchin (Social Anarchism or Lifestyle Anarchism, 'Internationalism') quotes Bakunin that those wishing peace should renounce the glory, might and greatness of the Fatherland, and FARJ (state section) says the state developed as conqueror waging wars to expand itself, as a vice.

torture-always-illegal.rationale: The qualifying sources record no position on this, and no stated principle settles it.

total-state.rationale: The qualifying sources record no position on this, and no stated principle settles it.

totalitarianisms-equivalent.rationale: Anarchists condemn both and also Bolshevism, but object to equating the two or to liberal framings.

traditional-family.rationale: Anarchists reject imposed hierarchy including patriarchal authority in the household, and Goldman attacked marriage; not a bedrock institution for them.

troops-home-from-abroad.rationale: The qualifying sources record no position on this, and no stated principle settles it.

turn-back-illegal-migrants.rationale: The qualifying sources record no position on this, and no stated principle settles it.

unbroken-national-continuity.rationale: Nulled: its only source, Social anarchism, isn't tied to the ideology.

uniform-civil-code.rationale: Nulled: its only source, Anarchy, isn't tied to the ideology.

uniformed-youth.rationale: Nulled: its only source, Anarchy, isn't tied to the ideology.

unions-good.rationale: Nulled: its only source, Anarchist Communism: Its Basis and Principles, isn't tied to the ideology.

unions-run-economy.rationale: The qualifying sources record no position on this, and no stated principle settles it.

universal-healthcare.rationale: Nulled: its only source, Social anarchism, isn't tied to the ideology.

universal-morality.rationale: Nulled: its only source, Anarchist Communism: Its Basis and Principles, isn't tied to the ideology.

unpaid-domestic-work-exploitation.rationale: The qualifying sources record no position on this, and no stated principle settles it.

vanguard-party.rationale: FARJ (political-level section) opposes the 'authoritarian vanguard organisation' that claims to illuminate the path of the people, and Bookchin (Post-Scarcity Anarchism) says a revolutionary group is a catalyst, not a 'vanguard'.

voluntary-union-payments-at-work.rationale: The qualifying sources record no position on this, and no stated principle settles it.

vote-at-sixteen.rationale: The qualifying sources record no position on this, and no stated principle settles it.

wages-fall-to-bare-minimum.rationale: FARJ (class and wage-labour section) says capitalists pay workers as little as possible and that unemployment gives them an abundant supply of workers when they go to market; the statement's 'bound to fall to subsistence' is stronger than what is said.

war-builds-character.rationale: Nulled: its only source, Anarchist Communism: Its Basis and Principles, isn't tied to the ideology.

wealth-concentration-endangers-liberty.rationale: Kropotkin (Conquest of Bread, ch. I 'Our Riches' and ch. III 'Anarchist Communism') argues that the rights of a few rich men are upheld by a repressive state apparatus and that wage exploitation finds its political form in parliamentary rule, so wealth and political liberty cannot coexist; FARJ names economic equality as a pillar of freedom.

widespread-small-property.rationale: FARJ (economy section) says private property would be abolished in favour of collective ownership with only individual possession of what one uses, and Bookchin (Post-Scarcity Anarchism, Introduction) says an anarcho-communist society presupposes the abolition of private property.

withdraw-from-politics.rationale: Social anarchism calls for direct participation in decision-making and social revolution, against lifestyle withdrawal.

women-equality-needs-economic-change.rationale: Bookchin (Post-Scarcity Anarchism, Introduction) traces the patriarchal family to the scarcity-based order of private property, class and state and says sexism and hierarchy do not vanish under a 'planned economy' or 'workers' state', tying ending women's subjugation to abolishing that order.

women-organise-apart-from-men.rationale: The qualifying sources record no position on this, and no stated principle settles it.

women-property-inheritance.rationale: Nulled: its only source, Anarchist Communism: Its Basis and Principles, isn't tied to the ideology.

work-centre-of-life.rationale: Bookchin, Post-Scarcity Anarchism (Introduction), lists a decisive reduction in time devoted to labor as part of an anarcho-communist society; Kropotkin, The Conquest of Bread (ch. IX 'The Need for Luxury'), has people do their duty to society in a few hours and spend the remaining leisure on science, art and their own pursuits.

work-for-welfare.rationale: Nulled: its only source, Anarchist Communism: Its Basis and Principles, isn't tied to the ideology.

worker-farmer-alliance.rationale: The qualifying sources record no position on this, and no stated principle settles it.

worker-ownership.rationale: FARJ (section on libertarian socialist economy) says private property is abolished and the means of production become collective property managed by the people who work them (self-management); this is society-wide collective ownership rather than ownership business by business, hence not full strength.

workers-anti-imperialist-capitalist-alli.rationale: Bookchin (Social Anarchism or Lifestyle Anarchism, 'The First World War and Bolshevism') criticises the shift from internationalism to national-liberation alliances, and FARJ (class-struggle sections) builds popular organisation of the exploited classes against capitalism, not partnership with business owners.

workers-councils.rationale: FARJ (economy section) places planning and distribution with self-managed workers' and consumers' councils and their federations, and Bookchin (Post-Scarcity Anarchism, essay on the Soviets) discusses councils and assemblies as popular organs, though he and FARJ favour direct assemblies over parliament-like bodies.

workers-nation.rationale: Bookchin (Social Anarchism or Lifestyle Anarchism, 'Internationalism, Nationalism, and Confederation') presents international class solidarity as the Left's and anarchists' principle, condemns socialists who backed their own states in the First World War, and treats nationalism as divisive.

workers-own-party.rationale: FARJ (section on representative democracy) rejects electoral parties as hierarchical bodies whose politicians put the party's interests first, though it favours a specific anarchist organisation; a working-class political party in the usual sense is not endorsed.

workers-parties-campaign-reforms.rationale: Bookchin (Social Anarchism or Lifestyle Anarchism, 'The Left That Was') says reforms for their own sake were never part of anarchist or revolutionary ideology and only served to mobilise the oppressed; FARJ (section on representative democracy) rejects electoral parties and politicians as a route.

workplace-democracy.rationale: FARJ (economy section) describes production run by workers' self-management with collective decisions and balanced task sets under collective ownership; this goes beyond a vote in a company to ending ownership by employers.

youth-equal-civil-rights.rationale: The qualifying sources record no position on this, and no stated principle settles it.

missingStatements.text: Society should be organized as a federation of voluntary associations built from the bottom up, rather than as a state.
missingStatements.rationale: The Conquest of Bread has free communes and federations of groups replace the state, and Bookchin looks to popular assemblies confederated into a counterpower.

notes: Answers rest on the Stanford Encyclopedia, Morland, the FARJ account, Bookchin's essay and Post-Scarcity Anarchism, and Kropotkin's Conquest of Bread; Kropotkin's pamphlet and Malatesta's Anarchy are untied and no longer cited. Bookchin's municipalism favours majority-vote assemblies where other anarchist writers distrust majorities. Themes searched: economy, ownership, labour, state, democracy, violence and revolution, organisation, ecology, technology, religion, nationalism, family. Most statements on specific laws, taxes, courts, foreign policy and identity are null: the sources state no position on them.
